name: Member access control
description: Flags access to a function or property whose @private or @protected visibility does not permit access from the current script.
definition: Flags, as an `[error]`, access to a function or property from a script that its visibility annotation does not permit. `@public` members (and unannotated members) are available from any script, `@protected` members are available only from their declaring script and its inheritors, and `@private` members are available only from their declaring script. This project-aware check follows inherited members and resolves typed properties, parameters, and local variables before checking access.
